title: God Be With You
lyrics: [A]God be with you till we meet [E]a-[A]gain;
[A]Till we meet, till we [D]meet, Till we [A]meet at Jesus' [E]feet,
[E]Till we [A]meet, till we [D]meet God be [A]with you till we meet [E]a-[A]gain.
God be with you till we meet again;
God be with you till we meet again.
God be with you till we meet again;
When life's perils thick confound you;
Put His arms unfailing round you;
God be with you till we meet again.
God be with you till we meet again;
Keep love's banner floating over you,
Strike death's threatening wave before you;
God be with you till we meet again.
